pages.text: Magnet upgrades are an evolution of the hopper upgrade and teleport items from a distance around them.$(p)The upgrades come in several strengths the affect their speed and collection radius.  If multiple upgrades are used, their ranges will be added together, up to an upper limit.
The base level magnet upgrade collects a stack of items every 20 ticks with a range of 1.
The second level magnet upgrade collects a stack of items every 10 ticks with a range of 4.
The third level magnet upgrade collects a stack of items every 5 ticks with a range of 8.
